```{r setup, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, echo = TRUE}
# ==========================================================
# Exploring the Multinomial Distribution
# ==========================================================
# This R Markdown script demonstrates how to simulate,
# analyze, and visualize data from a multinomial distribution.
# We model a survey of 100 respondents choosing their favorite
# color among four options: Red, Blue, Green, and Yellow.
# ==========================================================

# Load libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(reshape2)
library(MASS)

# Set seed for reproducibility
set.seed(123)

# Parameters
n <- 100
p <- c(0.25, 0.35, 0.30, 0.10)
categories <- c("Red", "Blue", "Green", "Yellow")

# Generate one sample
sample_counts <- rmultinom(1, size = n, prob = p)
rownames(sample_counts) <- categories
sample_counts

# Expected values and variances
expected_values <- n * p
variances <- n * p * (1 - p)

# Covariance matrix
cov_matrix <- matrix(0, nrow = 4, ncol = 4)
for (i in 1:4) {
  for (j in 1:4) {
    if (i == j) {
      cov_matrix[i, j] <- n * p[i] * (1 - p[i])
    } else {
      cov_matrix[i, j] <- -n * p[i] * p[j]
    }
  }
}
rownames(cov_matrix) <- colnames(cov_matrix) <- categories

# Display results
expected_values
variances
cov_matrix

# Simulate many samples
n_sim <- 10000
sim_data <- t(rmultinom(n_sim, size = n, prob = p))
colnames(sim_data) <- categories
sim_df <- as.data.frame(sim_data)
head(sim_df)

# Mean counts
mean_counts <- colMeans(sim_df)

# Combine data
plot_df <- data.frame(
  Category = categories,
  MeanCount = mean_counts,
  Expected = expected_values
)

# Plot mean simulated counts vs expected values
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Category, y = MeanCount, fill = Category)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", color = "black", alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_point(aes(y = Expected), color = "black", size = 3, shape = 17) +
  geom_text(aes(y = Expected + 1, label = paste("E[Y] =", round(Expected, 1))), size = 3.5) +
  labs(title = "Mean Simulated Counts vs. Expected Values",
       y = "Mean Count (across simulations)",
       x = "Color Category") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("blue", "green", "red", "gold")) +
  theme_minimal()

# Correlation heatmap
cor_matrix <- cor(sim_df)
melted_cor <- melt(cor_matrix)
ggplot(melted_cor, aes(x = Var1, y = Var2, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", value)), color = "black", size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient2(low = "red", high = "blue", mid = "white", midpoint = 0) +
  labs(title = "Correlation Between Category Counts (Multinomial Simulation)",
       x = "", y = "") +
  theme_minimal()
```
